# Sierra Stone South & Central Okanagan

> Sierra Stone South & Central Okanagan installs premium natural stone aggregate coatings over existing concrete, wood, and vinyl surfaces — pool decks, patios, driveways, front steps, and indoor floors. The product is real natural stone bonded with industrial-grade epoxy and finished with a UV-stable topcoat, engineered to last 20-25+ years through Okanagan freeze-thaw cycles and intense summer UV. We serve Kelowna, West Kelowna, Penticton, Vernon, Lake Country, Summerland, and Peachland.

- Phone: (250) 808-9425
- Email: info@sierrastonesouthcentral.com
- Service area: South and Central Okanagan, British Columbia, Canada
- Site: https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com

## Services

- [Pool Deck Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/pool-decks): Slip-resistant, UV-stable resurfacing for residential pool decks.
- [Patio & Deck Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/patios-and-decks): Natural stone finish over concrete, wood, or vinyl patios.
- [Driveway Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/driveways): Premium driveway resurfacing rated for vehicle traffic, salt, and freeze-thaw.
- [Front Steps & Walkway Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/front-steps): Slip-resistant textured aggregate for entry steps and walkways.
- [Indoor Stone Coating](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/indoor-surfaces): Stone-finished garage floors, basements, and commercial interiors.
- [Concrete Repair & Resurfacing](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/services/concrete-repair): Cosmetic concrete repair via stone resurfacing — typically half the cost of demo and re-pour.

## Cities Served

- [Kelowna](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/kelowna): Primary service hub — Lower Mission, Glenmore, Rutland, Kettle Valley, Dilworth, and all neighborhoods.
- [West Kelowna](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/west-kelowna): Lakeview Heights, Westbank, Glenrosa, Shannon Lake, Rose Valley.
- [Penticton](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/penticton): Skaha Lake, Upper Bench, Wiltse, Naramata Bench, Okanagan Falls.
- [Vernon](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/vernon): Coldstream, Predator Ridge, BX, Okanagan Landing, East Hill.
- [Lake Country](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/lake-country): Winfield, Oyama, Carr's Landing, Okanagan Centre.
- [Summerland](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/summerland): Trout Creek, Prairie Valley, Garnett Valley.
- [Peachland](https://sierrastonesouthcentral.com/peachland): Trepanier, Todd's Landing, Antlers Beach.
